evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $45,000,000; attorneys' fees $9,000,000; clear sailing no

evidence.agent: Ostrander Bell LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: The parties therefore agreed to the class fund and fee terms in the same counterproposal; attorneys’ fees were not discussed only after class relief had been agreed.
To direct more of the same overall budget to affected members, we propose increasing the class fund to $35 million and reducing fees to $3 million

summary: Plaintiff counsel first raised fees in an opening term sheet, and the parties negotiated fees alongside class relief rather than after settling the fund. Hargrove Lane explicitly proposed shifting part of the same budget from fees to the class. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for firm compensation, defense exploiting fee interests, or a misleading declaration.
